Chao's team executes a Smart Selfish Maneuver. They hide the conflict of interest (Secret Goal) behind a pretext of standard business relations, then project blame onto investigators by calling the factual reporting racist to distract the public.

The Unavoidable Truth: Chao held active roles in Chinese state-linked influence groups while serving as a U.S. Cabinet Secretary.
The Unavoidable Lie: The claim that these documented appointments are merely standard business meetings.
